deadline.value: No fixed deadline: positions are announced 2-4 times a year, each with its own deadline.
deadline.quote: with new opportunities announced 2–4 times per year

supervisor.value: You are admitted directly into a specific research project and group, so the position comes with its supervisor.
supervisor.quote: doctoral students are admitted directly into specific research projects and groups

funding.value: Doctoral students are employed by the university and receive a salary and employee benefits.
funding.quote: you receive a salary and employee benefits

entry_route.value: A master's degree, or 240 credits with 60 at second level, or equivalent; the faculty may grant exemptions.
entry_route.quote: A Master’s degree equivalent to at least 240 higher education credits, of which 60 credits must be at the advanced level, or equivalent qualifications

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

notes: Analytical, physical, materials, inorganic and organic chemistry plus neurochemistry. Biochemistry and Biophysics is a separate department and was not researched.
